section_summary.extract_value: This section details manipulation checks for goal commitment and goal frame. It reports that trainees were committed to their assigned goals and that the performance frame condition successfully induced a higher consequence focus (trying to perform better than others) compared to the learning frame condition. The sample size for the goal frame manipulation check was 540.
